**Daily Devotional**

**March 23**

*17 And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me,Fear not; I am the first and the last: (Revelation 1:17 KJV)*

Remember that this is the same John who leaned his head on Jesus’ bosom at the last supper (John 13:23). Although Jesus was still the same, His flesh no longer shielded His true nature from John, and in the Glory of Jesus in His resurrected body, John fell as if dead. This is common when people saw the true Glory of God, and if we saw His Glory, I am sure we would fall on our faces also. And to think, that we, who are born again, have this glory inside us (Romans 8:18).

This is what Paul was talking about when he said that they no longer knew Jesus in the flesh, but now in the Spirit (2 Corinthians 5:16). All through the ministry of Jesus on earth, His disciples never really knew who Jesus really was (John 14:9). They only knew Him in the flesh, and not who He was in the Spirit. We are actually fortunate that we don’t know Jesus in the flesh, as it makes us, through God’s Word, be able to have a better grasp of what Jesus is really like, and just who He really is. Many of us think we would love to have been there when Jesus was walking on this earth, but through the Holy Spirit and God’s Word, we can know Jesus much better than His disciples did. Thank you Lord for the Bible.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
